'''Briefing Room Three''' was a briefing room on the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']], used to prepare [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]]s for upcoming missions. [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] was briefed in this room in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] before taking part in the [[Battle of Kalla VII]].<ref name="Strategy Guide">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>
